value.text: All set, here's the plan for Ada. Registration opens Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. (America/New_York), and Hale will join right at the open. Sessions, in your order: 1) Preschool Swim Sun 10:00 ($98), 2) Preschool Swim Sat 9:00 ($98). Hale takes the first one that still has a spot, pays only with the card already saved on your city account, and won't go over $110. Hale will also tick the town's activity waiver at checkout. If anything gets in the way, like a captcha, a security code request, or a total over your maximum, Hale stops and leaves the cart for you. One thing to know: if you also queue on your own phone or computer, your family holds two places in line, and the town's queue counts that as more than one place. Hale will tell you how it went once the attempt is over.
